name: dsh-usd-3d-preview
description: In-browser OpenUSD 3D preview for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: registers a document preview for .usd/.usda/.usdc/.usdz, composes the stage with a WebAssembly OpenUSD engine (composition arcs included), renders it with three.js in a studio-lit viewport, and makes authored UsdPhysics joints and colliders interactive. Optional read-only S3-compatible asset-library support for `s3://` references. No converter process, no upload, no native toolchain
